projects.name: DataFlow
projects.description: A FastAPI-based data analysis system that turns uploaded files into interactive dashboards and pivot tables, with an AI chatbot for asking questions about processed datasets.
issuesResolved: Reduces manual effort when exploring uploaded datasets.
Makes trends and summaries easier to find in large files.
Lets users ask questions about processed data in natural language.
advantages: Combines file analysis, dashboards, and AI chat in one workflow.
Supports interactive dashboards and pivot-table exploration.

projects.name: MediCycle
projects.summary: Connect donated medicines with people in need.
projects.description: A platform for donating, listing, and finding affordable or free medicines, with an admin dashboard for managing medicines, requests, and organizational records.
issuesResolved: Provides a way to connect unused medicine with people who need it.
Helps users find affordable or free listed medicines.
Gives administrators tools to manage listings and requests.
advantages: Brings medicine donations and requests into one platform.
Supports both community users and administrators.

projects.name: Jarvis 2.0
projects.summary: A context-aware assistant for research and automation.
projects.description: A context-aware assistant powered by Gemma 2B and Mistral 7B through Ollama, combining retrieval-augmented generation with video and web scraping for automated information extraction.
issuesResolved: Reduces manual effort collecting information from web pages and videos.
Keeps responses grounded in the current conversation context.
advantages: Runs supported language models locally through Ollama.
Combines retrieval, scraping, and conversational assistance.

projects.name: MarketMatrix
projects.summary: Explore live crop and livestock market trends.
projects.description: A real-time market analysis tool for livestock and crop markets, with predictive insights, interactive charts, live market data, and automated trend evaluation.
issuesResolved: Makes market prices and trends easier to monitor in one place.
Helps users inspect changes across crop and livestock markets.
advantages: Pairs current market information with interactive visualizations.
Offers trend analysis to support informed decisions.

projects.name: Jarvis AI
projects.summary: A voice assistant for everyday tasks.
projects.description: A voice-controlled Python assistant for conversational AI, email, music playback, web searches, and time queries.
issuesResolved: Reduces the steps needed to perform common computer tasks.
Provides a voice-driven interface for searches and quick queries.

projects.name: Comment Cleanser
projects.summary: Classify harmful comments and learn from feedback.
projects.description: A Streamlit machine-learning app that classifies comments as hate speech, offensive, or clean, and can learn from user feedback.
issuesResolved: Helps identify hate speech and offensive comments.
Provides a way to incorporate user feedback into classification.
advantages: Separates comments into clear moderation categories.
Combines model predictions with a simple Streamlit interface.

projects.name: OSL
projects.summary: Predict SLA risks and machine failures.
projects.description: A machine-learning system for operational SLA and machine-failure prediction, with real-time monitoring and explainable results.
issuesResolved: Highlights potential SLA risks before they become operational issues.
Flags machine-failure risks for earlier investigation.
advantages: Combines monitoring with predictive alerts.
Uses SHAP to help explain model predictions.

projects.name: MAD
projects.summary: Check financial-plan eligibility and find nearby banks.
projects.description: A personal finance app that evaluates eligibility for loans, credit cards, insurance, investments, savings, salary accounts, tax-saving plans, and asset purchases. It collects financial details, provides plan-specific recommendations, and helps users discover nearby banks.
issuesResolved: Helps users understand eligibility across common financial products.
Reduces uncertainty when choosing a plan based on personal finances.
Helps users locate nearby banks for relevant plans.
advantages: Offers plan-specific eligibility checks and recommendations.
Uses account and financial details to personalize the flow.

projects.name: InnoHack 2.0
projects.summary: Explore legal documents and ask an AI lawyer.
projects.description: A legal AI platform featuring an AI lawyer chat assistant and tools for legal document handling and research, with a React-based web interface.
issuesResolved: Makes legal information and document workflows easier to access.
Provides a conversational way to explore legal questions.
advantages: Combines AI chat, document handling, and legal research features.
Offers a dedicated web interface for legal assistance.

projects.name: Dipex HackSense
projects.summary: Detect network threats and predict attack techniques.
projects.description: A network threat-detection project that extracts live traffic-flow features for intrusion classification and event prediction. Its dashboard accepts JSON, log, and text files and presents predicted attack techniques with confidence and priority information.
issuesResolved: Turns network events and uploaded logs into structured predictions.
Helps analysts review likely attack techniques and their priorities.
advantages: Combines traffic-feature analysis with event prediction.
Presents confidence and priority alongside predicted techniques.

projects.name: Smart Agri
projects.summary: Digital tools and information for farmers.
projects.description: A digital agriculture platform designed to give farmers access to practical information and services.
issuesResolved: Makes practical agricultural information and services easier to access.
advantages: Provides a digital entry point to farmer-focused resources.

projects.name: CityPulse
projects.summary: Report civic issues and track their resolution.
projects.description: A civic complaint platform where residents can report local issues with descriptions, photos, and location details, then track complaint status. Ward workers can manage assigned tasks, while ward and municipal dashboards provide city-wide complaint statistics and escalation tracking.
issuesResolved: Gives residents a structured way to report local civic issues.
Makes complaint progress visible to users and staff.
Helps municipal teams monitor ward activity and overdue complaints.
advantages: Connects citizen reporting with worker task management.
Provides ward-level and city-wide operational visibility.

projects.name: Breach Before It
projects.summary: Detect live intrusions and predict the next attack.
projects.description: A live network-security dashboard that captures packets, derives CIC-IDS flow features, and uses an XGBoost model to classify current traffic as benign or an attack. An LSTM analyzes recent attack categories to predict the next likely attack.
issuesResolved: Surfaces suspicious network traffic as it is captured.
Helps security teams anticipate likely follow-on attack categories.
advantages: Combines live flow analysis with sequential attack prediction.
Shows current classifications and predicted next attacks.

projects.name: Edubot
projects.summary: Chat with AI and retrieve educational information.
projects.description: An AI assistant with persistent conversations, document and image uploads, and OCR-based text extraction. Its tool-using language-model workflow can retrieve educational information such as college intake and seat-matrix data.
issuesResolved: Extracts readable text from uploaded images and documents.
Makes educational intake and seat-matrix information searchable through chat.
advantages: Maintains conversation history across topics.
Combines document processing with tool-assisted AI responses.
